plugins.name: task-station
plugins.description: Never lose your place in Claude Code — every task on one durable board, each wired to the session that holds its context, so you pick up exactly where you left off. A persistent, cross-session task hub: auto-categorised, terminal-tinted, with a structured per-task digest and in-project worker delegation, alongside Claude's native Tasks.
